description: Read the most recent messages in one DM conversation. conversation_id comes from list_inbox_dms. Pass the returned cursor to read older messages.

account.description: Connected account UUID or platform name that owns the conversation

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous call, to read older messages

peer_id.description: Only needed when the platform omits it

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

name: get_inbox_dm_thread
title: Get inbox dm thread
